from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


# ============================================================================
# Syntax Validation Tests
# ============================================================================


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Test parsing and validation of ISO 8601 duration syntax."""

    def test_p_required(self):
        """P must be present."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "1Y")

    def test_p_must_be_uppercase(self):
        """P must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1D")

    def test_empty_duration(self):
        """Just P without any component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_t_without_component(self):
        """T without a time component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_t_without_following_component(self):
        """T at end without time component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_valid_sign_plus(self):
        """Plus sign is accepted and changes nothing."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "+P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

    def test_valid_sign_minus(self):
        """Minus sign makes duration negative."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 2), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_sign_on_component_invalid(self):
        """Sign on individual component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P-1D")

    def test_component_order_violated_months_before_days(self):
        """Components must be in order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1M")

    def test_component_order_violated_time_before_days(self):
        """T must come after date components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H1D")

    def test_duplicate_year(self):
        """Year component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month(self):
        """Month component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_week(self):
        """Week component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W2W")

    def test_duplicate_day(self):
        """Day component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D2D")

    def test_duplicate_hour(self):
        """Hour component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H2H")

    def test_duplicate_minute(self):
        """Minute component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_second(self):
        """Second component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1S2S")

    def test_month_m_before_t(self):
        """M before T is months, not minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 1)

    def test_minute_m_after_t(self):
        """M after T is minutes, not months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "PT1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 1)

    def test_uppercase_designators_only(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1d")

    def test_lowercase_designators_invalid(self):
        """Lowercase designators are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1d")

    def test_whitespace_invalid(self):
        """No whitespace allowed anywhere."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P 1D")

    def test_week_alone_valid(self):
        """W can appear alone."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 8)

    def test_week_with_day_invalid(self):
        """W cannot be combined with days."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W1D")

    def test_week_with_month_invalid(self):
        """W cannot be combined with months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M1W")

    def test_week_with_time_invalid(self):
        """W cannot be combined with time components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1WT1H")

    def test_no_component_invalid(self):
        """At least one component is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_at_least_one_digit(self):
        """Component must have at least one digit."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PD")

    def test_leading_zeros_valid(self):
        """Leading zeros are allowed."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P01D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

class TestFractionalComponents:
    """Test fractional parts in duration components."""

    def test_fractional_seconds_dot(self):
        """Seconds can have fractional part with dot."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_comma(self):
        """Seconds can have fractional part with comma."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1,5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_minutes_dot(self):
        """Minutes can have fractional part with dot."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 1, 30)

    def test_fractional_hours_dot(self):
        """Hours can have fractional part with dot."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30)

    def test_fractional_days_dot(self):
        """Days can have fractional part with dot."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P1.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 12, 0)

    def test_fractional_weeks_dot(self):
        """Weeks can have fractional part with dot."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P1.5W")
        expected = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0) + timedelta(weeks=1.5)
        assert result == expected

    def test_fractional_years_invalid(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5Y")

    def test_fractional_months_invalid(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5M")

    def test_only_last_component_fractional_valid(self):
        """Only the last component can be fractional."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P1DT1H30.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 30, 30)

    def test_non_last_component_fractional_invalid(self):
        """Non-last component cannot be fractional."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5D1H")

    def test_fractional_missing_integer_part(self):
        """Fraction must have digit before decimal point."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT.5S")

    def test_fractional_missing_fractional_part(self):
        """Fraction must have digit after decimal point."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1.S")

    def test_zero_fractional_valid(self):
        """Zero fractional part is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000)

    def test_fractional_rounding_to_microsecond(self):
        """Fractions are rounded to nearest microsecond."""
        # 1.0000005 seconds should round to 1.000001 seconds
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1.0000005S")
        assert result.microsecond == 1

class TestBasicApplication:
    """Test applying durations to datetimes."""

    def test_add_zero_duration_invalid(self):
        """P without components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_add_one_year(self):
        """Adding one year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 15)

    def test_add_multiple_years(self):
        """Adding multiple years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P5Y")
        assert result == datetime(2030, 1, 15)

    def test_add_one_month(self):
        """Adding one month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_add_multiple_months(self):
        """Adding multiple months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 4, 15)

    def test_add_months_wrapping_year(self):
        """Adding months that wrap to next year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 11, 15), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 15)

    def test_add_one_week(self):
        """Adding one week."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 8)

    def test_add_multiple_weeks(self):
        """Adding multiple weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P3W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 22)

    def test_add_one_day(self):
        """Adding one day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

    def test_add_multiple_days(self):
        """Adding multiple days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 11)

    def test_add_one_hour(self):
        """Adding one hour."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "PT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 11, 0)

    def test_add_multiple_hours(self):
        """Adding multiple hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "PT5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 15, 0)

    def test_add_one_minute(self):
        """Adding one minute."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "PT1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 1)

    def test_add_multiple_minutes(self):
        """Adding multiple minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30)

    def test_add_one_second(self):
        """Adding one second."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 1)

    def test_add_multiple_seconds(self):
        """Adding multiple seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0), "PT45S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 45)

class TestCombinedComponents:
    """Test durations with multiple components."""

    def test_year_and_month(self):
        """Adding years and months together."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1Y2M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 15)

    def test_year_month_and_day(self):
        """Adding years, months and days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1Y2M3D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 18)

    def test_all_components(self):
        """Adding all date and time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 30, 45), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 18, 14, 35, 51)

    def test_time_components_only(self):
        """Adding only time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30, 45), "PT1H2M3S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 11, 32, 48)

    def test_mixed_fractional_and_whole(self):
        """Mixing fractional and whole components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P1DT1H30.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 30, 30)

class TestMonthYearEdgeCases:
    """Test month and year application with day overflow."""

    def test_jan_31_plus_month_becomes_feb_28_nonleap(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28 in non-leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_jan_31_plus_month_becomes_feb_29_leap(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 29 in leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_mar_31_plus_month_becomes_apr_30(self):
        """Mar 31 + 1 month = Apr 30 (Apr has 30 days)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 4, 30)

    def test_multiple_months_overflow(self):
        """Multiple months can cause overflow."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 31)

    def test_year_and_month_overflow(self):
        """Year and month together can cause overflow."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_year_leap_to_nonleap(self):
        """Feb 29 to non-leap year becomes Feb 28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_year_nonleap_to_leap(self):
        """Feb 28 to leap year becomes Feb 28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 28), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_months_exact_landing(self):
        """Multiple months can land exactly on valid day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P13M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 15)

    def test_months_then_days_applied_separately(self):
        """Months and days applied separately in correct order."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 1)

    def test_thirteen_months_in_one_step(self):
        """P1Y1M applies 13 months in one step, not separately."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)

    def test_time_preserved_during_month_adjustment(self):
        """Time is preserved when adjusting for month overflow."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31, 15, 30, 45, 123456), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28, 15, 30, 45, 123456)

class TestNegativeDurations:
    """Test negative durations."""

    def test_negative_one_year(self):
        """Subtracting one year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "-P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 15)

    def test_negative_one_month(self):
        """Subtracting one month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 15), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_negative_one_day(self):
        """Subtracting one day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 2), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_negative_one_hour(self):
        """Subtracting one hour."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "-PT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 9, 0)

    def test_negative_multiple_components(self):
        """Subtracting multiple components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 31)

    def test_negative_duration_month_overflow(self):
        """Negative duration with month overflow."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_negative_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Subtracting fractional seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 2), "-PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_negative_fractional_hours(self):
        """Subtracting fractional hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0), "-PT1.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30)

    def test_negative_months_first_then_days(self):
        """Months applied first, then days negated."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        # First back 1 month: 2024-02-01
        # Then back 1 day: 2024-01-31
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_negative_months_with_overflow(self):
        """Negative months with day overflow."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

class TestFractionalApplications:
    """Test application of fractional durations."""

    def test_half_day_is_12_hours(self):
        """P0.5D equals 12 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0)

    def test_half_hour_is_30_minutes(self):
        """PT0.5H equals 30 minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT0.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30)

    def test_half_minute_is_30_seconds(self):
        """PT0.5M equals 30 seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30)

    def test_half_week_is_3_5_days(self):
        """P0.5W equals 3.5 days equals 84 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12, 0)

    def test_fractional_seconds_microsecond_precision(self):
        """Fractional seconds maintain microsecond precision."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_complex_fractional_calculation(self):
        """Complex fractional duration calculation."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P1.5DT2.5H")
        # 1.5 days + 2.5 hours = 36 + 2.5 hours = 38.5 hours
        expected = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0) + timedelta(hours=38.5)
        assert result == expected

class TestBoundaryConditions:
    """Test boundary conditions and datetime range limits."""

    def test_datetime_min_boundary(self):
        """Cannot go before datetime.min."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            # datetime.min is 0001-01-01, subtract 1 year
            add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 1), "-P1Y")

    def test_datetime_max_boundary(self):
        """Cannot go after datetime.max."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            # datetime.max is 9999-12-31, add 1 year
            add_duration(datetime(9999, 12, 31), "P1Y")

    def test_near_min_boundary_valid(self):
        """Adding near minimum is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(1, 2, 1), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(1, 1, 1)

    def test_near_max_boundary_valid(self):
        """Adding near maximum is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(9999, 12, 1), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(9999, 12, 2)

    def test_midnight_boundary(self):
        """Crossing midnight works correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23, 0), "PT2H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 0)

    def test_year_boundary(self):
        """Crossing year boundary works correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 31), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 1)

    def test_leap_second_handling(self):
        """Leap second is a valid time component."""
        # datetime doesn't support leap seconds, but we can have 59 seconds
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 59), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0)

class TestLargeDurations:
    """Test large duration values."""

    def test_large_year_value(self):

    def test_large_month_value(self):
        """Adding large number of months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P100M")

    def test_large_day_value(self):
        """Adding large number of days."""

        assert result == expected

    def test_large_time_value(self):
        """Adding large number of time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "PT1000H")
        expected = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0) + timedelta(hours=1000)

class TestApplicationOrder:
    """Test that components are applied in the correct order."""

    def test_months_before_days(self):
        """Months applied before days."""
        # Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28 (overflow)
        # Then + 3 days = Mar 3
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M3D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 3)

    def test_weeks_as_exact_multiples(self):
        """Weeks are applied as exact multiples of 7 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_time_applied_last(self):
        """Time components applied after date components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "P1DT5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 15, 0)

    def test_negative_months_then_days(self):
        """Negative: months applied before days."""
        # 2024-03-31 - 1 month = 2024-02-29
        # 2024-02-29 - 1 day = 2024-02-28
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 28)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


# ============================================================================
# SYNTAX AND PARSING TESTS
# ============================================================================

class TestBasicSyntax:
    """Test basic valid and invalid syntax patterns."""

    def test_single_year(self):
        """Single year component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 15)

    def test_single_month(self):
        """Single month component before T."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 4, 15)

    def test_single_week(self):
        """Single week component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 22)

    def test_single_day(self):
        """Single day component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16)

class TestYearMonth:
    """Test year and month addition with calendar rules."""

    def test_add_month_simple(self):
        """Add one month to a date."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 15)

    def test_add_year_simple(self):
        """Add one year to a date."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 15)

    def test_add_year_and_month(self):
        """Add both year and month in one operation."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)

    def test_month_end_clamping_jan_31_plus_1_month(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month should be Feb 28/29 (last day of target month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)  # 2024 is leap year

    def test_month_end_clamping_jan_31_plus_1_month_non_leap(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month in non-leap year should be Feb 28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2023, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 2, 28)

    def test_month_end_clamping_mar_31_plus_1_month(self):
        """Mar 31 + 1 month should be Apr 30."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 4, 30)

    def test_month_end_clamping_multiple_months(self):
        """Jan 31 + 13 months should clamp in Feb of next year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_add_12_months_equals_add_year(self):
        """Adding 12 months should be same as adding a year."""
        d = datetime(2020, 1, 15)
        result_months = add_duration(d, "P12M")
        result_year = add_duration(d, "P1Y")
        assert result_months == result_year

    def test_negative_month(self):
        """Subtract one month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 15)

    def test_negative_year(self):
        """Subtract one year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2019, 3, 15)

    def test_negative_multiple_months(self):
        """Subtract multiple months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P5M")
        assert result == datetime(2019, 10, 15)

    def test_month_end_clamping_negative(self):
        """Mar 31 - 1 month should be Feb 29 (leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_leap_year_feb_29_plus_year(self):
        """Feb 29 in leap year + 1 year = Feb 28 in non-leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_leap_year_feb_29_plus_4_years(self):
        """Feb 29 + 4 years should stay Feb 29 (next leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P4Y")
        assert result == datetime(2028, 2, 29)

    def test_time_preserved_with_month_addition(self):
        """Time components should be preserved when adding months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15, 14, 30, 45, 123456), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 15, 14, 30, 45, 123456)

    def test_many_months(self):
        """Add many months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P36M")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 1, 15)

    def test_months_wrapping_years(self):
        """Month addition should handle year boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 11, 15), "P4M")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 15)

        """Century years (divisible by 100 but not 400) are not leap."""
        # 1900 is not a leap year
        result = add_duration(datetime(1900, 2, 28), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(1900, 3, 1)

    def test_divisible_400_leap_year(self):
        """Years divisible by 400 are leap years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2000, 2, 28), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2000, 2, 29)

    def test_month_end_edge_case_31_to_30(self):
        """31st day of month with 30 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 5, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 6, 30)

    def test_month_end_edge_case_multiple_31_months(self):
        """Multiple operations across months with 31 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 31), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 31)

    def test_month_end_edge_case_31_to_february(self):
        """31st of month + month → February (28 or 29)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 29)

    def test_month_end_edge_case_31_to_february_non_leap(self):
        """31st of month + month → February 28 in non-leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2021, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 2, 28)

    def test_datetime_min_value(self):
        """Test near minimum datetime value."""
        min_date = datetime(1, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(min_date, "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(1, 1, 2)

    def test_datetime_max_value(self):
        """Test near maximum datetime value."""
        max_date = datetime(9999, 12, 31)
        result = add_duration(max_date, "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(9999, 12, 30)

    def test_datetime_range_overflow_add(self):
        """Adding duration that exceeds datetime max should raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(9999, 12, 31), "P1D")

    def test_datetime_range_overflow_subtract(self):
        """Subtracting duration that goes below datetime min should raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 1), "-P1D")

    def test_very_large_positive_duration(self):
        """Very large positive duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2000, 1, 1), "P10000D")
        expected_days = 10000
        expected = datetime(2000, 1, 1) + timedelta(days=expected_days)
        assert result == expected

    def test_very_large_negative_duration(self):
        """Very large negative duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2030, 1, 1), "-P10000D")
        expected_days = -10000
        expected = datetime(2030, 1, 1) + timedelta(days=expected_days)
        assert result == expected

    def test_midnight_boundary(self):
        """Operations across midnight."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 23, 59, 59), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_year_boundary(self):
        """Operations across year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 12, 31), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 1, 1)

    def test_microseconds_preserved(self):
        """Microseconds should be preserved in operations."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45, 123456), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 10, 30, 45, 123456)

    def test_zero_duration(self):
        """Adding zero duration returns the same datetime."""
        d = datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45, 123456)
        result = add_duration(d, "P0D")
        assert result == d

    def test_multiple_zero_components(self):
        """Duration with multiple zero components."""
        d = datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45, 123456)
        result = add_duration(d, "P0Y0M0DT0H0M0S")
        assert result == d

    def test_very_small_fractional_second(self):
        """Very small fractional second (near rounding limit)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0), "PT0.0000001S")
        # 0.0000001 seconds = 0.1 microseconds, rounds to 0
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_rounding_half_up(self):
        """Rounding behavior at 0.5 microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0), "PT0.0000015S")
        # 0.0000015 seconds = 1.5 microseconds, should round to 2
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0, 2)

class TestSpecCompliance:

    def test_spec_example_p1y2m10dt2h30m(self):

        """Specification example: 2024-01-31 + P1M = 2024-02-29."""

        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_spec_feb_29_plus_1y1m(self):
        """Specification example: 2024-02-29 + P1Y1M = 2025-03-29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)

    def test_spec_mar_31_minus_1_month(self):
        """Specification example: 2024-03-31 - P1M = 2024-02-29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_spec_mar_1_minus_1m1d(self):
        """Specification example: 2024-03-01 - P1M1D = 2024-01-31."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_fractional_p05d(self):
        """P0.5D is 12 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_pt05h(self):
        """PT0.5H is 30 minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0), "PT0.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 0)

    def test_fractional_p05w(self):
        """P0.5W is 3.5 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 18, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_no_timezone_aware_datetime(self):
        """Specification requires naive datetimes (no timezones)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1D")
        assert result.tzinfo is None

    def test_microsecond_precision_maintained(self):
        """Microsecond precision should be maintained."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 0, 0, 500000), "P1D")
        assert result.microsecond == 500000

    def test_decimal_separator_dot(self):
        """Decimal separator can be a dot."""
        result_dot = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 0), "P1.5D")
        assert result_dot == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 12)

    def test_decimal_separator_comma(self):
        """Decimal separator can be a comma."""
        result_comma = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 0), "P1,5D")
        assert result_comma == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 12)

    def test_month_clamping_description(self):
        """Test the month clamping rule as described in spec."""
        # "If the day of month does not exist in the target month, 
        # use the last day of that month"
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 29)

    def test_months_in_one_step(self):
        """Test that years and months are applied in one step."""
        # "Move by 12 * years + months calendar months in one step"
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
        # Should move 13 months total
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)
